answer_1.quote: We use the WMT 2018 Parallel Corpus Filtering shared task as a benchmark to evaluate our methods... The quality of the resulting subsets is determined by training a neural machine translation system (Marian) on this data. The quality of the machine translation system is measured by BLEU score on six test sets.
